cagents-cagents:lever:3e725377-f02a-4dff.description: Commissioning Engineer - Electrical CAI is a 100% employee-owned company established in 1996, that has grown year over year to almost 750 people worldwide. We provide commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, project management and other consulting services to mission critical industries. We are global partner in providing professional services to enhance operational performance and reliability. We deliver consistently. Expertly. Completely. CAI India is seeking 3 to 8 years experienced Electrical testing, Commissioning Engineers to support our Data Centre Projects across the country. These are full-time opportunities with competitive compensation and benefits. As consultants to the entire industry, our Commissioning professionals are driven by the challenge and constant diversity of assignments, while having the stability of a company that has never had a lay off. On any given day we could be responsible for a myriad of things involved in starting a facility, equipment or process up including protocol writing and execution, FAT's SAT's, walk downs and development of summary reports at the client site. Commissioning Engineers will work as part of the CAI Data centre/ Building commissioning team and be responsible for commissioning, safe work practices, facility turnover, and issue resolution. Our Commissioning professionals develop and execute the commissioning tests to demonstrate to the customer that vendor equipment is correctly installed and set to work, support enhanced design reviews, and consult on submission of LEED qualification packages. Requirements include: · BE/BTech in Electrical Engineering · 3 to 8 years or more of experience in testing, commissioning and qualification jobs · Excellent oral and written communication skills in English · Able to travel domestically and internationally, as and when required · Relocation to Client sites is a prerequisite Experience in the following: · Development of all Electrical test procedures, MOPS, SOO’s and checklists. · QA/QC of all Electrical test procedures. · Assist with vendor coordination and management. · Perform equipment inspection to ensure build adherence to vendor submittal. · QA/QC of Electrical equipment installation\startup. · Develop reports for the Electrical testing and contribute to a daily report to the Commissioning Project Manager. · Execute test scripts to confirm equipment and system operation to design specification. · Support and perform design specification review, manufacturer submittals, one line drawing sets, and project schedule documentation. · Ensure safe work practices are followed by the commissioning team and customer site. Others Primarily working for India region commissioning projects Expected to support other Data Centre/Building commissioning projects in other global regions. This job description is not all inclusive and you may be asked to do other duties related to the CAI projects.

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:87.description: Our client is a premier utility company specializing in rapid response and storm chasing to utility companies and contractors in need of a quick reaction force to repair power outages when they need it most. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide reliable and efficient solutions to help our clients restore power quickly and effectively during emergencies and adverse weather conditions while ensuring operational efficiency and financial sustainability. Our customers are our communities, and when they need us, we are there. We are seeking a skilled and experienced Fleet Mechanic to maintain our fleet maintenance while supporting our rapid response and restoration services. The Fleet Operations Lead Mechanic will play a critical role in the upkept and readiness of our fleet of vehicles, equipment, and assets to ensure optimal performance, safety, and efficiency. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in commercial vehicle maintenance and maintenance schedules.
responsibilities: Fleet Maintenance:
Regularly review preventative maintenance schedules and ensure all vehicles are being maintained according to schedule
Diagnoses minor mechanical and electronic problems, utilizing diagnostic computer when applicable
Addresses all identified maintenance needs in an efficient manner while ensuring compliance with maintenance reporting requirements
Oversees and leads the emergency response maintenance and repairs as needed
Asset Availability & Utilization:
Ensure repairs are efficiently addressed to maintain asset availability for projects, jobs, and emergency responses.
Analyze asset data to identify opportunities for optimization, including right-sizing the fleet, improving asset utilization, and minimizing downtime.
Assist in developing preventive maintenance schedules and programs to extend the lifespan of fleet assets and reduce maintenance costs.
Equipment Safety and Compliance:
Assist in enforcing safety policies and procedures to ensure the safe operation of fleet vehicles and equipment.
Participate in regular safety training and inspections, addressing any safety concerns or violations promptly.
Assist in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including vehicle inspections, emissions testing, and driver licensing.
Emergency Response Support:
Assist in deploying fleet assets and personnel rapidly in response to emergencies and power outages.
Assist to ensure the readiness and availability of fleet resources during emergency situations.
Oversees and efficiently utilizes emergency mechanical support to ensure any mechanical opportunities are effectively addressed.
qualifications: Certifications in commercial fleet maintenance, as well as a minimum of 5 years proven fleet maintenance experience.
Strong knowledge of vehicle maintenance schedules, hands-on experience in diesel engine and/or heavy vehicle maintenance, diagnosis, repair, and safety compliance.
Excellent communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
CDL Preferred

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:021b0afe-16b5-4bd2.title: Data Labeling Specialist
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:021b0afe-16b5-4bd2.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Data Labeling Specialist, щоб разом піднімати планку результату. Хто такий Data Labeling Specialist у нашій команді Це людина яка допомагає нейромережам розуміти контексти. Твоя роль - детальна розмітка фото та текстів за гайдлайнами. Ти не просто видаляєш контент а стаєш вчителем для ШІ де кожне твоє рішення стає еталоном для майбутніх технологій. Твої цілі на цій посаді: — Досягати та підтримувати стабільно високу швидкість обробки даних без втрати якості та точності кожного окремого рішення; — Активно сприяти формуванню єдиної логіки команди під час обговорення складних кейсів для мінімізації розбіжностей у розмітці; — Демонструвати виняткову гнучкість через швидке опанування нових типів проектів. Що для нас важливо: — Здатність приймати логічні рішення на основі великих обсягів інформації; — Вміння чітко аргументувати свою думку та пояснити логіку вибору; — Англійська мова на рівні B1; — Готовність до активної командної роботи; — Швидка адаптація до нових правил розмітки які можуть динамічно змінюватись; — Наявність власного ноутбука або ПК та стабільного інтернет-з’єднання; — Буде плюсом, якщо ти вже працював над розмітками для ML. Що ти отримаєш разом з нами: — Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: маркетинг, розробка, фінанси, рекрутинг; — Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій; — Стабільність у проекті що постійно масштабується; — Можливість професійно зростати як вертикально так і горизонтально; — Команда де цінують твою логіку та здатність відстоювати власну думку; — Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар. Робочий графік 2/2 з 10:00 до 18:00. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: — SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek a skilled supervisor to drive results. This individual will need to be the gold standard in all our processes, so attention to detail and high drive to win is a must. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You will manage a team of highly trained, optimistic Advisors, Operators, and Attendants to provide exceptional guest service in a fun, interactive atmosphere. We need a dedicated team member that has experience in a supervisory role, and a willingness to learn the car wash industry. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:23ae2577-3a3.title: Project Lion - Lead Prompt Engineer - United States (Remote, Part-Time)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:23ae2577-3a3.description: We are looking for an experienced Lead Prompt Engineer to guide and manage a team through the full technical migration process, transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. In this role, you will leverage advanced prompt engineering techniques and the client’s internal tools to optimize model performance, ensuring the successful integration and ongoing enhancement of AI systems. As the team lead, you will drive the strategy, mentor junior engineers, and play a key role in shaping the future of our AI-driven solutions.
responsibilities: Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters.
Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus.

Manually draft, test, and refine prompts to navigate complex template architectures, overcome anti-patterns, and handle edge cases where tooling is lacking or broken. Solve edge-case scenarios by designing and refining manual prompts.
Monitor shadowbot runs to ensure sufficient disagreements (between human and LLM ratings) are registered, generated, and tracked.
Run prompt versions against established gold data to continuously measure autorater quality against the human crowd baseline, calculating accuracy metrics such as F1 scores, precision, and recall.
Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final.
qualifications: Language Skills : Native fluency in English.
Location:   Must be based in United States.
Education : Master’s, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, or a related analytical field.

Prompt Engineering & AI Expertise : At least 7 years' experience as Prompt Engineer. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning.
Data Analysis : Strong proficiency in identifying error patterns, analyzing model performance, and using SQL or other data analytics tools.
Technical Agility : Ability to quickly learn and master proprietary tools with minimal supervision.
Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Familiarity with enterprise-grade LLM interfaces like the Goose API.
Experience in AI model evaluation, data science, computational linguistics, or software engineering.
Hands-on experience with Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) systems or tuning workflows.
Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:2f64e944-65d.description: Overview Welo Data is looking for detail-oriented and reliable individuals to join our team as Data Labeling Analysts, supporting speech and voice AI systems. This is a high-impact production role focused on building the datasets that power real-world AI systems. You’ll be working with audio, speech, and language data — helping ensure models are trained on accurate, well-structured, and representative inputs. While this role is more execution-focused than evaluation-heavy roles, it still requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and consistency. The work sits at the intersection of language, data, and AI systems — where precision and discipline matter at scale. We’re looking for people who are dependable, focused, and take pride in producing high-quality work, even across repetitive workflows. Project Details Job Title: Data Labeling Analyst Hiring in: Onsite (Bay Area, Seattle, NYC, or client-dependent) Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week Employment Type: W2 Full-Time Employee Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. (no visa sponsorship) Pay Rate: $26 - $28/hour Important: This is a 100% onsite position — remote work is not available for this role. To be considered, candidates must be located in or able to commute to one of the following cities: NYC, Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond, San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Burlingame, Austin, Los Angeles, Washington DC, Chicago, Boston. Please only apply if you meet this location requirement.
